_comment: Rules for collapsing rows of MonsterDatabase-DelvingDeeper.csv into one entry of the Monster Level Tables. PROVISIONAL: to be settled in step 2. Rows named 'N Hit Dice X' and 'N-Headed Hydra' are collapsed automatically by build.py. Each rule: a regex on the monster name; 'family' is the entry label, 'member' the text listed in parentheses (regex backreferences allowed); 'level' pins the family to one table regardless of EHD; 'drop' removes matching rows from the tables.
